title: [@tailcall] on a local function or a method call is not checked
summary: `[@tailcall]` on a call of a local function that is not a tail call (`1 + (g [@tailcall]) x`) gets no warning 51, because the function has been made a continuation before the check; `ocamlc -g` gives the warning. `[@tailcall]` on a method call is dropped without a word.

expected.text: Warning 51 (`expected tailcall`) at lines 3 and 7, here an error; exit status 2.
